eval: (async()=>{const c=document.getElementById('game');const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();const s=Game.scale,oy=Game.oy;const P=(dx,dy)=>({clientX:r.left+dx*s,clientY:r.top+oy+dy*s});const sleep=ms=>new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,ms));const settle=async()=>{for(let i=0;i<150;i++){if(Game.grid.animInPlay===0&&Tween.list.length===0){await sleep(150);if(Game.grid.animInPlay===0&&Tween.list.length===0)return;}await sleep(80);}};const shoot=async(col)=>{const x=CONF.GRID.x+(col+0.5)*CONF.CELL_W,y=CONF.BORN.y;c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{pointerId:1,bubbles:true,...P(x,y)}));c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{pointerId:1,bubbles:true,...P(x,y-160)}));await sleep(50);c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{pointerId:1,bubbles:true,...P(x,y-160)}));await settle();};Game.model.data.inGuide=false;Game.grid.guideVisible=false;Game.grid.guideStep=-1;const trace=[];const origEmit=EventCenter.event.bind(EventCenter);EventCenter.event=function(t,...a){if(t==='block_combine'){trace.push('COMBINE ids='+a[0].map(b=>b.id+':'+b.value).join(','));}if(t==='block_disappear'||t==='block_remove'){trace.push(t+' id='+a[0].id);}return origEmit(t,...a);};const cols=[2,2,1,1,3];for(const col of cols){await shoot(col);}await settle();EventCenter.event=origEmit;const model=[];for(let x=0;x<5;x++)for(let y=0;y<8;y++){const b=Game.model.getBlock(x,y);if(b)model.push(b.id+':'+x+','+y+'='+b.value);}const views=[...Game.grid.blocks.entries()].map(([k,v])=>k+':'+Math.round(v.vx)+','+Math.round(v.vy)+'='+v.value);return JSON.stringify({trace,model,views});})()
